'''Glaucus''' was a [[Octeroid]] [[Gender|male]] who was also known by the nicknames '''"Big Guy"''' and '''"Big Eye"'''. In [[10 BBY]], Glaucus spent time watching matches of [[sabacc]] in [[the Lodge]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] and witnessed matches between the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. He preferred spectating to playing as other players could see his card values reflected in his [[eye]].

==Biography==
[[File:Lodge_players.png|thumb|left|Glaucus watched sabacc at the Lodge.|250px]]
In the [[Standard year|year]] [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the portion of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' set on [[Vandor]] to nine [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the founding of the Empire to [[19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Octeroid]] [[Gender|male]] Glaucus spent time in the establishment known as [[the Lodge]] in [[Fort Ypso]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]]. While there he was one of many patrons who crowded around a table in the back room to watch and play games of [[sabacc]].<ref name="SoloOG" />

While he stood by the table he witnessed matches involving the [[Gambling|gamblers]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], [[Argus Panox]], [[Karjj]], [[Thermoculus Krisintvolt Scissorpunch|Therm Scissorpunch]], [[Dava Cassamam]], [[Lark and Jonk]]. As Glaucus watched, the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] arrived and joined the game, eventually gaining the upper hand and a large share of winnings. Solo eventually lost it all against Calrissian, who cheated by using a concealed sylop card to win.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Glaucus.png|thumb|right|180px|Glaucus' nicknames included "Big Guy" and "Big Eye"]]
Due to his limited grasp of [[Galactic Basic Standard]], Glaucus did not notice the difference between the two nicknames he was known by; "Big Guy" and "Big Eye". He preferred spectating to playing himself due to the fact that his [[Limb|hands]] were too small to conceal his cards and their values were often reflected in his [[eye]], giving other players an advantage. The Octeroid had [[Color|green]] skin and a yellow eye.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Equipment==
He wore a brown [[Clothing|robe]] with a brown [[Hair|fur]] [[Cape|cloak]] over it and had [[atmosphere]] exchange breathing tubes connected to a collar around his neck.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Maverick_004.png|thumb|right|175px|Ivan Manzella illustrated concept art of Glaucus.]]
Glaucus was created for the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first revealed in the film's first trailer.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|jPEYpryMp2s|Solo: A Star Wars Story Official Trailer|sw_url=video/official-trailer-solo-a-star-wars-story}}</ref> Concept art of Glaucus title "Maverick 004" was created by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]] for ''Solo''.<ref name="Art of Solo">''[[The Art of Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> The character first received identification in the reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="SoloOG" />

In an interview with [[StarWars.com]], creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]] revealed that for Glaucus' design, like [[Lark and Jonk]]'s, Ivan Manzella was influenced by the space monster feel of the [[1950s]], taking as inspiration what would have influenced the designers had ''Solo'' been released in [[1960s#1965|1965]], ten years prior to [[1977]], year in which the original ''[[Star Wars]]'' film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], was released.<ref name="Glaucus' Design">{{SW|url=news/solo-a-star-wars-story-designs|text=Inside the Designs of ''Solo: A Star Wars Story''}}</ref>
